text: **dsh-plugin-wiki-skills**（DSH 插件，web 客户端）：把随包提供的 Obsidian 知识库技能注册到 DSH 的 skills 服务。插件扫描并读取技能目录中的 Markdown 与 YAML frontmatter，提供 wiki 搭建、资料摄入、知识库问答、健康检查、对话保存，以及 Obsidian 格式参考等能力。技能可由用户或模型调用，并以只读 bundled provider 供发现和加载。适合希望在 DSH 中建立并维护持久知识库的用户；安装后使用自带技能，若需要自动化的查询、写入和检查工具，需另配配套工具包。

**dsh-plugin-wiki-skills** (DSH web plugin) bundles Obsidian skills for wiki setup, source ingestion, cited answers, health checks, conversation saving, and syntax help. Its read-only provider exposes Markdown skills to users and models; native query, write, and lint tools need a companion package.
想在 DSH 里搭建并持续维护一个 Obsidian 知识库
有没有办法把资料整理成互相链接的知识库页面
我想让 DSH 根据已有笔记回答问题并附上出处
怎样检查知识库里的孤立页面和失效链接
能不能把刚才的对话结论保存为知识库笔记
需要一套 Obsidian Markdown 和 Bases 格式编写参考
Help me ingest source material into linked notes in my Obsidian vault
I want answers from my wiki with citations and a way to save useful results
知识库问答：按问题从热缓存、索引和相关页面读取内容并综合回答，支持快速、标准和深入模式，可引用页面来源。
资料摄入：读取文件、网址或批次来源，提取概念并创建或更新知识库页面，再补充交叉引用与操作记录。
知识库健康检查：查找孤立页面、失效链接、frontmatter 缺项和空章节，并生成维护报告或仪表板。
保存对话：将当前对话、回答或见解整理成结构化笔记，并更新知识库索引、日志和热缓存。
技能目录加载：读取每个技能的 YAML frontmatter 和 Markdown 正文，校验名称与描述后登记为用户和模型可调用的 bundled 技能。
dsh-plugin-wiki-skills 主要提供提示词技能；wiki 查询、写入、重命名和健康检查的原生机械工具由 README 提到的配套 dsh-plugin-wiki-tools 提供，需另行安装。

The [claude-obsidian](https://github.com/AgriciDaniel/claude-obsidian)-derived knowledge-suite skills as a [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin: `wiki`, `wiki-ingest`, `wiki-query`, `wiki-lint`, and `save`, mounted on the `ctx.skills` registry as a read-only bundled provider.

dsh-plugin-wiki-skills README · dsh-plugin-wiki-skills：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-wiki-skills
```

*If this suite helps you, a ⭐ helps other dsh users find it. 如果这套技能帮到了你，欢迎点个 Star。*

dsh-plugin-wiki-skills README · Attribution：The five skills are adapted from [claude-obsidian](https://github.com/AgriciDaniel/claude-obsidian) by AgriciDaniel (AI Marketing Hub), MIT licensed — see [ORIGINAL_LICENSE](ORIGINAL_LICENSE). The adaptation is based on the v1-era prompt-centric skills, substantially rewritten for ZCode and now for dsh. Changes made in this adaptation:

dsh-plugin-wiki-skills README · Attribution：- Removed the upstream Community Footer (promotional block) and the routing rows for sub-skills not bundled here (`autoresearch`, `canvas`).
- Added a `dsh adaptation` note to each skill: upstream product scripts (transport detection, `wiki-mode.py`, `wiki-lock.sh`, DragonScale address allocation, `.vault-meta/`) are not bundled; the companion package **[dsh-plugin-wiki-tools](https://github.com/Lion-1209/dsh-plugin-wiki-tools)** provides native tools for the mechanical core.
dsh-plugin-wiki-skills README · Attribution：The vault design itself follows the [LLM Wiki pattern](https://github.com/karpathy) described by Andrej Karpathy.

dsh-plugin-wiki-skills README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-wiki-skills
```

The package declares a `dsh.bundle` patch that inserts one `wiki-skills` row. Pair it with `dsh-plugin-wiki-tools` for the native `wiki_query` / `wiki_write` / `wiki_lint` tools, and with [dsh-wiki-web](https://github.com/Lion-1209/dsh-wiki-web) for a self-hosted web UI over the same vault.

dsh-plugin-wiki-skills README · Skills：| Skill | Routes when |
| --- | --- |
| `wiki` | Vault setup, scaffolding, cross-project referencing, hot-cache management |
| `wiki-ingest` | Ingest sources into the vault: extract entities/concepts, cross-reference, log |
| `wiki-query` | Answer from the vault: hot cache → index → pages, with citations |
| `wiki-lint` | Health check: orphans, dead links, frontmatter gaps, stale index entries |
| `save` | File conversation insights back into the vault |
| `think` | The 10-principle reasoning loop (OBSERVE…GROW) every wiki skill maps onto |
| `obsidian-markdown` | Obsidian Flavored Markdown syntax reference (wikilinks, callouts, embeds) |
| `obsidian-bases` | Obsidian Bases reference for data views over note properties |
| `defuddle` | Cleaning fetched web pages before ingestion (ad-free readable text) |

dsh-plugin-wiki-skills README · Skills：The upstream `autoresearch`, `canvas`, `wiki-cli`, `wiki-fold`, `wiki-mode`, and `wiki-retrieve` skills are not bundled: their script-bound mechanics are covered natively by [dsh-plugin-wiki-tools](https://github.com/Lion-1209/dsh-plugin-wiki-tools) (query/write/rename/scaffold/archive/lint with BM25 retrieval); the research and canvas workflows remain upstream features.

dsh-plugin-wiki-skills README · Behavior：- Registers one provider named `wiki-skills` with bundled-rank (600) candidates, so project, runtime, and user skills with the same name win over this suite.
- Each skill declares `resourceBase: directory`, letting bodies reference sibling files under `references/`.
- Malformed frontmatter fails loud at discovery instead of silently skipping a skill.

dsh-plugin-wiki-skills README · Develop：```sh
npm install
node --test
```
